title: GameChainConfig
description: Heterogeneous game-chain — ONE lesson/unit container that delivers an ORDERED sequence of two or more complete game-type components (for example matching → puzzle-split → tap-recognition → drag-sort → quiz) as one coherent objective. Components always run in array order (concrete/simple → complex/application, never shuffled). Each component carries its own full sub-game config; components may not nest game-chain. The 5–10 playable-item rule applies to each component; the chain may contain more than 10 total items because it is a lesson container, not one homogeneous game.

characters.description: Recurring host character(s) shown between rounds.

rounds.description: Ordered heterogeneous components — each is a WHOLE sub-game for one lesson/unit objective. Renderers MUST play them in array order; the order is the pedagogy. Each component independently contains 5–10 playable items.

label.description: Short round name shown in the progress strip, e.g. 'Sort the shapes', 'Label the face'

template.description: Sub-game template for this component. game-chain (no nesting) is excluded; puzzle-split is allowed as a complete component.

config.description: Full sub-game config for `template` (must itself carry template/lessonId/ageLevel/category/tier/item_id + the template's content collections). Validated against that template's rules at save time.

promptMode.description: Overall presentation hint; each round keeps its own modes.
